ModMetaData.name: Regions and Societies: Empire Patch
ModMetaData.author: Regions and Societies Team
ModMetaData.description:
Compatibility patch: Empire Refactored colonies are classified, populated and owned under Regions and Societies territory rules, and Empire's settlement placement, reward economy and tithe respect regional ownership.
This patch binds directly against Empire's assembly, so its settlements are recognised by real type and member rather than by name guessing. Requires both Regions and Societies and Empire Refactored.
